The test image shows a soybean leaf with small, scattered reddish-brown spots distributed across the upper surface. The spots appear small, roughly 2-5mm, reddish-brown to tan colored, with no obvious halos. Veins remain green. This is clearly a leaf symptom.

Now let me check the part index to narrow candidates.

Leaf candidates: Anthracnose, Bacterial_Blight, Bacterial_Pustule, Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus, Brown_Stem_Rot, Cercospora, Downy_mildew, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Phyllosticta_leaf_spot, Powdery_Mildew, Septoria_brown_spot, Soybean_rust, Sudden_death_syndrome, Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus, Soybean_Cyst_Nematode.

Key features: small, scattered reddish-brown to tan spots on upper leaf surface, ~2-5mm, no halos, green veins intact. Top candidates: Septoria_brown_spot, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Soybean_rust, Cercospora.

Let me view one reference from each top candidate class:
This Septoria reference shows large yellow/brown blotches with heavy spotting - more severe than test image. Let me check Frogeye leaf spot next.
This frogeye reference shows small circular spots with fallen tissue - somewhat similar. Let me check soybean rust.
Soybean rust shows very similar small scattered reddish-brown spots. This is a strong match. Let me check Cercospora next.
Cercospora shows extensive bronzing/reddening covering most of leaf - very different from test image. Let me check Bacterial_Pustule.
Very close-up/macro shot, doesn't match test. Let me check Downy_mildew.
Downy mildew shows yellow-green spots, not reddish-brown. Let me check Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus.
Large irregular lesions along veins - doesn't match. Let me view Sudden_death_syndrome for my 8th class.

SDS shows interveinal chlorosis/necrosis - clearly different from test image.

**Analysis summary:**
- Test image: small, numerous, discrete reddish-brown/tan spots uniformly scattered across a green leaf upper surface
- Soybean rust reference (Soybean_Dise_74): extremely similar - many small tan to reddish-brown spots scattered across green leaf
- Septoria brown spot: larger coalescing yellow/brown blotches
- Frogeye: small spots but with distinct gray centers and holes
- Cercospora: extensive bronze/reddish-brown coverage over most leaf
- Downy mildew: yellow-green spots
- Vein necrosis virus: large irregular lesions along veins
- SDS: interveinal chlorosis/necrosis with green veins

The small, numerous, scattered reddish-brown spots on an otherwise green leaf match soybean rust best. The rust reference image was nearly identical in appearance and pattern to the test image.
